coordinateNotes.native: current semantic crop-local texture pixels; old landmark - old origin + current origin
coordinateNotes.worldPreservedNative: current crop coordinates of PRE-v4 world position; currentOrigin + (oldLandmark-oldOrigin)*oldScale/currentScale; do not use for texture retarget
coordinateNotes.mappingJustification: v4 apply.py keeps torso/limb texture pixels unchanged, recrops/translates the atlas, and applies body scale at runtime; its head-only resampling does not move these body joints
coordinateNotes.confidence: minimum of existing MediaPipe visibility/presence; not independent anatomical truth
coordinateNotes.fallback: missing, unsupported, low-confidence or lying poses are flagged; no fabricated replacement landmarks
